results.name: real IndexedDB persists exact source/schema and both history branches across reload
dialog waits for explicit restore and blocks replacing unreviewed recovery
UI redo and undo checkpoint exact revised values and source dirty baseline
workspace and independent window scopes are isolated in actual IndexedDB
close and reopen restore user editing and undo history without native document writes
real cross-page atomic CAS accepts exactly one simultaneous writer
stale UI write preserves live edit, old checkpoint and offers explicit export/retry
cancelled close preserves uncheckpointed edits; forced reload retains only acknowledged prior checkpoint
failed durable write preserves current fields and previous record; retry succeeds after failure clears
discard cancels safely, then atomically removes only the selected checkpoint
actual file inputs create a fresh durable checkpoint before reporting recovery saved
corrupt IndexedDB record is not silently repaired, replaced or exposed in an editable dialog
owned fixture bytes remain unchanged; no external requests or browser errors

scope: Isolated headless Edge, owned XML/XSD, real IndexedDB and UI recovery. No Windows desktop input, Hancom or real OS file-dialog comparison. Quota failure deliberately injected before durable write.
